game.title: Kabaddi (Pakistan Style)
game.description: Pakistan's version of kabaddi, known as 'Circle Kabaddi' played in a circular field. One of the most popular traditional sports with passionate followings and international competitions.
howToPlay: Step 1: Played in a circular field instead of rectangular court.
Step 2: Two teams of eight players occupy opposite halves.
Step 3: Raider enters opponent's half chanting 'kabaddi' without taking breath.
Step 4: Raider attempts to tag defenders and return to their half.
Step 5: Defenders try to tackle the raider.
Step 6: Points scored for successful tags.
Step 7: Circle kabaddi allows more players and different tackling techniques.
Step 8: Teams alternate raiders throughout the game.
Step 9: Pakistan has strong kabaddi tradition with world-class players.
Step 10: Major tournaments held during national holidays.
